frameworks.name: Qwen2.5-VL
frameworks.key_advantage: Dynamic native-resolution ViT with window attention, structured JSON invoice/form bounding-box extraction, and hour-long video event localization.

frameworks.name: MiniCPM-o 2.6
frameworks.category_role: Edge Omni-Modal Vision, Speech & Live Video Model (8B)
frameworks.key_advantage: High-token-density visual encoding (1.8M pixels in 640 tokens) with real-time bilingual speech and live video streaming on iPad/Mac/edge GPUs.

frameworks.name: LLaVA-OneVision
frameworks.category_role: Unified Single-Image, Multi-Image & Video Instruction VLM
frameworks.key_advantage: Foundational visual instruction tuning ecosystem with AnyRes multi-frame transfer across single-image, multi-image, and video tasks.

frameworks.name: allenai/olmOCR
frameworks.category_role: High-Throughput PDF & Multi-Column Document OCR Pipeline
frameworks.key_advantage: Document-anchoring VLM fine-tuned on 260,000+ complex PDF pages with reading-order preservation, tables, equations, and vLLM batching at $31 per 1M pages.

frameworks.name: InternVL 2.5

frameworks.name: Moondream 2B
frameworks.category_role: Sub-2B Ultra-Lightweight Edge & Browser Vision Model
